description: This file defines the BasketQueryService class, which implements the IBasketQueryService interface. It provides database access logic to count total basket items for a user in an e-commerce application, using Entity Framework Core for database queries.

classes.name: BasketQueryService
classes.description: Implements IBasketQueryService to perform database queries related to the user's shopping basket, specifically counting total items.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously counts total number of items in a user's basket using database aggregation with SumAsync.

methods.name: BasketQueryService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a database context.
